built_from: out/linguascrape-full/corpus (jobs/linguascrape-full.yml) -> culturescrape datalog-materialize --exclude contemporary precedes follows
note: Release record for the materialised Datalog inference over the full LinguaScrape convergence corpus, regenerated at the Phase-1 full-rebuild benchmark (US-005) against the post-US-001 edge model. 'base_relations' counts the edge predicates the shared rules read; 'derived_relations' is the engine-free fixpoint extension of each STRUCTURAL rule (culturescrape.datalog.materialize). These TYPE counts are the DETERMINISTIC fingerprint of the derivation over this corpus; they track the live corpus, so regenerate with the command in docs/convergence-build.md 'Materialize Datalog inference at scale (US-004)' after any rebuild. The corpus and its corpus-datalog export are gitignored. 'engine_only' lists the arithmetic temporal rules (contemporary/precedes/follows): US-001 turned these from stored O(n^2) edges into rules over time_start/time_end, so the engine-free naive-fixpoint evaluator would recompute their ~10^6-pair span-overlap join every round -- intractable at full scale (the pre-US-001 manifest recorded contemporary=1037028 only because contemporary_with was then a 518514-edge stored base relation). They are validated engine-side (the CI cross-engine equivalence test over fixtures) and by the materializer over the small bundled fixture; a real swipl/souffle derives them lazily at query time. genetic_linguistic_correlation is 0 here because LinguaScrape ships no genetics domain (no haplogroup source); the rule materialises on a merged corpus that includes one -- see the shipped genetic-linguistic-correlation example over the bundled fixture.
